Frequently.title: What is a centralized crypto exchange, and how does it work?
Frequently.desc: A centralized crypto exchange (CEX) is a digital asset trading platform managed by a central authority. Users register, deposit funds, and trade cryptocurrencies using the platform's internal systems. The exchange handles custody, order matching, and security to ensure smooth transactions.

Frequently.title: Why should I choose a centralized exchange over a decentralized one?
Frequently.desc: Centralized exchanges offer faster transactions, better liquidity, user-friendly interfaces, and robust customer support. They are ideal for beginners and businesses aiming for scalability, regulatory compliance, and integrated fiat support.

Frequently.title: How much does it cost to develop a centralized cryptocurrency exchange?
Frequently.desc: The development cost varies based on features, tech stack, and customizations. On average, it ranges between $30,000 to $200,000+, depending on functionalities like KYC/AML, trading engine complexity, wallet integrations, and third-party APIs.

Frequently.title: How long does it take to build a centralized crypto exchange platform?
Frequently.desc: The timeline typically ranges from 3 to 6 months. However, with white-label solutions or clone scripts (e.g., Binance or Coinbase clone), the time can be reduced significantly to 4–8 weeks, depending on customization needs.

Frequently.title: What security features should a centralized crypto exchange have?
Frequently.desc: A secure exchange must include 2FA, SSL encryption, cold wallet integration, anti-DDoS, KYC/AML compliance, and real-time monitoring. At Comfygen, we implement multi-layered security protocols for user and fund protection.

Frequently.title: Can I launch a Binance or Coinbase-like exchange with your clone solutions?
Frequently.desc: Absolutely. We offer customizable Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, and other popular exchange clones tailored to your business model. These white-label solutions are scalable, secure, and quick to deploy.

Frequently.title: Do you provide post-launch technical support and maintenance?
Frequently.desc: Yes. We offer 24/7 technical support, ongoing updates, server monitoring, and feature upgrades to keep your exchange secure and operational even after launch.

Frequently.title: Is your centralized exchange development compliant with global crypto regulations?
Frequently.desc: Yes. We integrate KYC/AML modules and help clients comply with local and international laws. Our legal team offers guidance on crypto licensing, privacy policies, and token classifications to ensure regulatory compliance.
